summary: On OpenShift, change the controller certificate by creating a TLS secret (oc create secret tls) and setting spec.controller.route_tls_secret on the AnsibleAutomationPlatform custom resource; verify with openssl s_client.
questions: How do I change the automation controller certificate on OpenShift?
Replace the controller route TLS certificate with the operator

answer_card.title: Controller route certificate on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc create secret tls controller-certs-$(date +%F) --cert=/path/to/ssl.crt --key=/path/to/ssl.key -n <namespace>
oc edit ansibleautomationplatform <aap-instance-name> -n <namespace>
```
```yaml
spec:
  controller:
    route_tls_secret: controller-certs-2024-03-24
```
Wait a few minutes, then `true | openssl s_client -showcerts -connect ${CONTROLLER_FQDN}:443`.
